text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Breastfeeding Jaundice (likely due to insufficient intake/dehydration, though late-onset timing warrants ruling out biliary pathology or hemolysis). The 2-day onset in a 2-week-old exclusively breastfed infant is atypical for simple physiological jaundice but consistent with failure to thrive or dehydration.
